{{Top|leg}}
'''Viscountess''' was a title of [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] and a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] equivalent to [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscount]]. Viscountess [[Mireya]] hailed from [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]], [[Marriage/Legends|married]] into [[House Mecetti]] through [[High Lord]] [[Tritum XI]], and turned the house's [[Mecrosa Order]] protectors into a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] of [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> Viscountess [[Whirry Malreaux]] was a member of [[House Malreaux]] on Vjun.<ref name="DR Yoda">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
